items.label: section_header
items.text: SUMMARISING THE MAIN FEATURES OF THE GROUP 7 ELEMENTS

items.label: text
items.text: Group7elements:

items.label: list_item
items.text: have diatomic molecules, X2 (e.g. F2, Cl2, Br2)

items.label: list_item
items.text: go from gases to liquid to solid as you move down the group: the melting points and boiling points increase down the group

items.label: list_item
items.text: have coloured poisonous vapours: the colours of the elements get darker down the group

items.label: list_item
items.text: form compounds with the formula HX (e.g. HF, HCl, HBr) when reacted with hydrogen and these dissolve in water to form acids

items.label: list_item
items.text: form ionic salts with metals and covalent compounds with non-metals

items.label: list_item
items.text: form X- (e.g. F-, Cl-, Br-) ions in ionic compounds

items.label: list_item
items.text: become less reactive towards the bottom of the group

items.label: list_item
items.text: will displace elements lower down the group from their salts.

items.label: text
items.text: We can use these properties and trends to predict the properties of astatine, the element below iodine in Group 7. Astatine is an extremely rare radioactive element and no one has ever seen a sample of it, but we can predict that it:

items.label: list_item
items.text: will be a darker colour than iodine, very dark grey or black

items.label: list_item
items.text: will be a solid at room temperature and have a higher melting point than iodine

items.label: list_item
items.text: will be diatomic and contain At2 molecules

items.label: list_item
items.text: will react with hydrogen to form HAt, which will dissolve in water to form an acid

items.label: list_item
items.text: will form the salt NaAt with sodium or KAt with potassium

items.label: list_item
items.text: will contain the astatide ion (At-) in its ionic salts

items.label: list_item
items.text: will be less reactive than iodine

items.label: list_item
items.text: will be displaced from solution by iodine
